name: status-cycle
title: Status Cycle
description: A centred line whose status pill cycles: the label rolls up behind a hard clip while the pill's width springs past its target and back, and the line re-centres around it. The field then crossfades and a column of chips steps up from below. Copy, palette and every timing are props; the curves are fitted from frame measurements, not eyeballed.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/status-cycle?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
